title: Menu
description: Fiori menu with single/multiple checkable groups, icons, additional text, submenus, separators and disabled items (ui5-menu).

usage.summary: Let users choose commands from an opened hierarchy of menu items.
useWhen: Offer related commands from a button or contextual opener instead of navigating to another page.
Group commands and expose submenus when actions have a hierarchy.
Use MenuGroup checkMode="single" or "multiple" when menu commands represent checked choices.

avoidWhen.when: Show mixed contextual information or editable content beside an opener on every device.
Show mixed contextual content anchored on desktop and in a full-screen phone dialog.
Require a form or explicit confirmation before users resume the page.
Show the signed-in user, account information, user settings and sign-out actions.
